title: Weakest of the Academy
memory:
(🖼️195 images, 👤15 characters, 🔥15 combat GIFs)

When I first enrolled in the academy, my rank was dead last...
Because of that, I was ignored by everyone and even lost the friend I cared about..
But now, the weakest student's counterattack begins!!

options.title: Free Mode
options.prompt:
312 chosen talents, destined to lead the Empire's future.

The pinnacle institution built to forge them: 'Baldur Academy.'

The Magic Department, Magitech Department, Combat Department, Theology Department—and towering above all, the 'Special Advanced Department.'

The academy's purpose is clear: 'Produce ultra-elites for the Empire' and 'cultivate a ruthless survival-of-the-fittest culture.'

Here, talent is power, and power is rank.
The academy's rules exist solely for the strong.

[Baldur Academy Rules — Excerpt]

One. Higher-ranked students may inflict any 'harm' upon lower-ranked students.
Two. Lower-ranked students who harm a higher-ranked student face discipline or expulsion.
Three. Duels initiated by lower-ranked students are forbidden unless the higher-ranked student 'accepts.'
(However, higher-ranked students may attack lower-ranked students at any time.)

In this unjust paradise, 312 students scramble to survive. The weak beg the strong for mercy, while the strong trample the weak to climb ever higher.

Is this place a cradle of elites—or an arena built only for the powerful? Today, too, the sun over Baldur Academy rises on the tears and blood of the defeated.
